items.title: Burak Basel - Personal History Disclosure SHORT Form
items.description: Please submit the Personal History Disclosure SHORT Form in this application (QPA/2025/04334).

items.title: Burak Basel - Proof of Employment
items.description: Please provide proof of current employment. All documents submitted must be certified as true copies. Please upload the document(s) in the Ancillary Documents section of the base application QPA/2024/00747.

items.title: George Bergmann
items.description: According to the Curaçao Commercial Register, George Bergmann is no longer the managing director of the CSP eMoore N.V. Please remove his role in the portal accordingly.

items.title: Jared Vivas - Personal History Disclosure SHORT Form
items.description: Please add Jared Vivas to the portal and submit the Personal History Disclosure SHORT Form in this application.

items.title: Jared Vivas - Personal History Disclosure Form
items.description: Please upload the Personal History Disclosure Form in the base application QPA/2026/04704.

items.title: Jared Vivas - Criminal Record
items.description: Please upload a certified true copy of a criminal record in the base application QPA/2026/04704. The criminal record must have been issued within the last six months and certified as a true copy. If the criminal record is not in English, an English translation certified by the translator must also be submitted. Please note that a criminal record is required for every jurisdiction where the person has lived for more than six months in the last two years.

items.title: Jared Vivas - Bank Reference Letter
items.description: Please submit a certified true copy of a bank reference letter in the base application QPA/2026/04704. The bank reference letter must be on bank letterhead, must have been issued within the last six months, and must be certified as a true copy.

items.title: Stefanie Knoester - Personal History Disclosure SHORT Form
items.description: Please add Stefanie Knoester to the portal and submit the Personal History Disclosure SHORT Form in this application.

items.title: Stefanie Knoester - Personal History Disclosure Form
items.description: Please upload the Personal History Disclosure Form in the base application QPA/2026/04634.

items.title: Stefanie Knoester - Criminal Record
items.description: The criminal record submitted in the base application QPA/2026/04634 cannot be accepted because it was issued more than six months ago.

items.title: Stefanie Knoester - Bank Reference Letter
items.description: Please submit a certified true copy of a bank reference letter in the base application QPA/2026/04634. The bank reference letter must be on bank letterhead, must have been issued within the last six months, and must be certified as a true copy.

items.description: As per the business plan, Murat Ceylan is the managing director. Please add him to the portal and upload the Personal History Disclosure Form and all enclosures (with the exception of source of wealth).

items.title: Compliance Officer
items.description: Please add the Compliance Officer to the portal and submit the Personal History Disclosure Form, enclosures, letter of engagement (signed by the Compliance Officer and the Managing Director), and Curriculum Vitae (CV). Appointment of a compliance officer is mandatory. Note: If the Compliance Officer already has a base application in the portal, upload the Personal History Disclosure Short Form and the letter of engagement in this application. The CV and all other enclosures must be submitted in the base application.
